subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After this PR is rebased to use `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should maintainers require live Matrix/Element send-read proof before merge, or accept the in-memory Matrix adapter proof as enough?
rationale: Repository policy requires real behavior proof for external PRs, but the contributor says they lack Matrix homeserver credentials and the code-path proof is otherwise targeted.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element send-read log, transcript, terminal output, or short recording before merge.

options.title: Accept source-path proof after rebase
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly waive live transport proof once the code is rebased onto the canonical reasoning gate.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element send-read log, transcript, terminal output, or short recording before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current-main reasoning payload gate that this PR needs to target, so he is the best available routing owner for the proof and API-direction call.
